payload.headline: Run fgos git recover to clear interrupted pre-attempt land chain on main

parts.cause: Ticket c-47511 failed during verify when disk reached 0 bytes free. Operation land-4033127 was left in prepared state under writer 4033120, refusing new lands by other writers until recovered.

options.does: Owner executes fgos git recover from the main checkout to settle abandoned pre-attempt WAL chains.
options.gain: Clears the stranded land chain and unblocks landing supervision-powers-cores/p03.
options.harm: Requires human execution of one CLI command.
options.label: Run fgos git recover on main checkout

options.does: Leave the branch unmerged and wait without clearing the WAL chain.
options.harm: Blocks Phase 3, Phase 4 and Phase 5 indefinitely.
options.label: Abort Phase 3 and wait

parts.recommendation: Run fgos git recover on the main checkout, then wake lead to continue.

scope.allows: Settle interrupted land-4033127 chain using the standard recovery door.
scope.forbids: Manual deletion of WAL files or bypassing the git land door.

parts.what: Land on main failed with land-abandoned-writer-mismatch due to an interrupted pre-attempt Land chain left by a prior crashed runner when disk hit 100% full.
